subject.title: Connection / pairing reliability — local and remote

question: Which connection and recovery cases should this child uniquely own beyond the parent epic and the active remote token/approval issue?
rationale: Current main has shipped substantial pairing and recovery hardening, while this item's wording duplicates the parent outcome and does not identify a distinct remaining deliverable.

options.title: Narrow the child
options.body: Define a concrete uncovered local/remote restart and recovery matrix and retain this issue as the implementation owner for that bounded work.

options.title: Consolidate explicitly
options.body: Move any unique acceptance criteria into the parent epic or active remote issue, then close this child through explicit maintainer action.

recommendation.title: Narrow the child
recommendation.body: Define a concrete uncovered local/remote restart and recovery matrix and retain this issue as the implementation owner for that bounded work.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the parent epic and this child and are best positioned to clarify the intended work decomposition.
